technicalGate.passCriteria: Every applicable objective has an objective-specific passed or valid not-applicable result, the result artifact is SHA-256 hashed, and the result is bound to the exact release revision.
technicalGate.failCriteria: At least one objective-specific exact-revision technical result is failed.
technicalGate.pendingCriteria: One or more objectives lack an objective-specific exact-revision result; candidate artifacts alone do not pass the gate.

humanReview.completionCriteria: An authorized organization reviewer or assessor completes the applicable review and records a final signed disposition artifact within the authorized scope.
humanReview.pendingCriteria: No authorized final human disposition artifact has been supplied.
